texts: About 6,000,000 Americans are estimated to have congestive heart failure: C.
In the picture, the jam of yellow taxis curls into one giant 6 on Nami's map; a side street of a few taxis is far too few, the whole map far too many.
About half a million new cases are diagnosed each year, and heart failure is the leading cause of hospital admission in people over 65.
Only a few thousand hearts are transplanted each year, which is why mechanical support and cell therapy are being explored.
Memory hook: the taxi jam draws a giant 6 across the map: six million.
